operation.label: X post search
operation.does: finds public X posts that match search words and operators, with each post's author and engagement

expand_urls.description: When true, auto-crawl entity URLs and attach crawled_content to tweets. Off by default: responses can grow by up to 4KB per expanded URL. Use glim_web_crawl(url) for targeted crawls instead.

query.description: X search terms, not a sentence: a few keywords plus operators such as from:handle, min_faves:N or since:YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. x402 from:coinbase min_faves:50. A sentence matches few or no posts. Put the sort in `sort`, not here. min_faves holds only with sort "latest": under "top", posts below it still come back.

sort.description: Sort order: "top" (most engaged matching tweets) or "latest" (newest first). Default: "top".
